subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to London. Your departure is scheduled for April 15th at 10:00 AM from JFK International Airport. Please ensure you arrive at least two hours before your flight for check-in and security procedures. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Sincerely, The Travel Agency Team
